_comment: marble_tower: Map 2's guard tower, the Bentham drawing's -- ONE round stone shaft of constant diameter (r 7.0) on two low steps rising from the spike floor, opening at the guard floor into an ARCADE (pass 5, Ryan: the drawing's columns are arches, not just props under a dome): sixteen 0.30 m columns at bearings 25 + 22.5k, each rising 3.20 m from the room floor to a springing at z 4.90, JOINED BY SIXTEEN ROUND ARCHES of span 2.43 and rise 1.22 whose crowns stand at 6.12 on the facet corner lines, with a 0.88 m spandrel over each crown; the arches carry the ring beam (7.00..7.50, no exposed underside -- the arcade's head is solid corner to corner) and the dome (7.5..12.9) on top of it. The sixteen arched openings are still centred on 36.25 + 22.5k, so TowerVariant's 43 deg plugs at 25 + 45k are unchanged. A 1.2 m balcony ledge round the shaft, FLAT with the room floor at z 1.70, with a 1.0 m railing of 32 iron posts, a mid and a top rail (rail top 2.70, under the guard's sight line from the 0.6 m dais to the lane). Origin = the guard-room datum as tower.glb: the room floor is z 1.70, the guard's eye 3.95 on the dais, the foot z -26.35 (the spike floor, world y -1.0, when the scene's Tower node stands at y 25.35). ELEVEN surfaces, one tiling sheet a material class (lib/texel.py), world-projected at the rotunda's own density -- WALL_MPT 0.046 m a texel, a sheet 12 courses of 1.0 m tall phased on the spike floor, so the shaft's courses run round all sixteen facets at one height on the same world 1 m grid the rotunda's wall uses and their vertical joints stand on the facet corners (60 texels across = 16 repeats at r 7.0; the balcony's 35 = 32 repeats at r 8.2). Classes: stone (shaft, spandrels), plinth, shade (reveals, soffits, undersides), marble2 (ledge), band (ring beam, slab edge), column, iron, floor, medallion (the dais' centre disc, box-projected: its face rings the axis, where a polar unwrap has no frame), coffer and dome -- the two shells of the dome, whose UVs are stated per vertex from azimuth and MERIDIAN ARC LENGTH, so a texel is the same size at the spring and at the crown and the band closes round with no seam. MarbleTowerCollision rides in the .glb as a `-colonly` node (foot, steps, shaft, slab, ledge, an invisible band at r 8.12 from 1.70 to 2.70 in place of the railing, room floor, plain full-height column boxes -- a body cannot walk into an arch's head, so the collider keeps the cheap colonnade and its flat soffit -- and the ring beam closed with a flat ceiling; the dome is out of reach); Godot turns it into a StaticBody3D + ConcavePolygonShape3D and drops its mesh, so `surfaces` counts only what is drawn. max_tris 5250 (the room floor's 32 paving cells are split 3 x 3 on their slab joints, 576 tris, so every joint is a true ring or radial edge): the arcade is 4380 tris -- the sixteen pierced screens (two faces, jamb reveals, arch soffits, spandrel strips) cost 1152 of them and the beam's two station-split faces 384, against 128 + 192 for pass 4's bare columns and soffit; the railing (32 posts, two rails) is the other big line.
